name: fotbalek-web-styles
description: Front-end asset build for Fotbalek.Web. Compiles Styles/app.css -> wwwroot/app.css and vendors the icon font.
//: Every version is pinned exactly, on purpose. wwwroot/app.css and wwwroot/lib are committed build outputs, so a floating range means one developer's `npm install` silently rewrites a checked-in artifact. @tailwindcss/cli and tailwindcss must also stay on the same version (the CLI depends on tailwindcss exactly), and app.css imports 'tailwindcss/...' directly, so tailwindcss is a real direct dependency rather than a redundant one.
